          about

          I haven’t released music in a long time. But recently, my family has been going through something that made me want to hit the stu again.

          My six year old nephew Aiden is battling cancer.. and I been trying to figure out how I can help my sister and her family through this difficult time.

          Music has always been a part of my life, and I realized this was one way I could contribute while also giving something back to the people who been supporting me over the years.

          That’s how ALL WE HAVE came together.

          I made the album available for everyone to name their own price, all proceeds will go to help support Aiden and his family, you can choose any amount when purchasing.

          No matter what you give, you’ll receive the entire album.

          Thank you for supporting my family and giving me another reason to make music.

          — China Mac
